podcast.body: This song was recorded by Wilson Pickett at FAME Studios in Muscle Shoals, Alabama, and released by Atlantic Records in 1966. Its soulful sound exemplified the type of hits Atlantic was producing with the Muscle Shoals Rhythm Section, influencing the future trajectory of soul music and Aretha Franklin's career reboot. "Once Mustang Sally by Wilson Pickett recorded at the celebrated fame studios in Muscle Shoals, Alabama and released by Atlantic Records in 1966."
